author: shuvamk
description:
Nuggets is a premium Next.js template crafted for modern digital agencies. With its sleek design, smooth animations, and comprehensive features, it provides everything needed to establish a compelling online presence.

Key Features:

Modern Technology Stack
Next.js 14 with App Router
TypeScript for robust development
Tailwind CSS for styling
Framer Motion animations
Supabase backend integration
Lucide React icons
Professional Design
Clean, modern aesthetics
Micro-interactions throughout
Fully responsive design
Custom animations
Interactive components
Bold typography system
Complete Feature Set
Dynamic blog platform
Contact form with database integration
Service showcases
Process timeline
Client statistics
Team section
Privacy Policy & Terms pages
Comprehensive footer
Performance & SEO
Optimized meta tags
SEO-friendly structure
Open Graph support
Twitter Card integration
PWA-ready
Cross-browser compatible
Business Features
Lead capture system
Service presentation
Client statistics
Process explanation
Content management
Social integration
Developer Experience
Clean, modular code
TypeScript integration
Component architecture
Utility-first CSS
Easy customization
Detailed documentation
